change.description: Restore same-identity Product Release recovery after frozen inputs and add deterministic frozen-media preflight before image packaging.
change.release_unit_description: static frontend and full-feature Docker image

planned.reasoning: This is a backward-compatible release operations fix. It preserves release identity, version allocation, source binding, artifact retention, product formats, transport and required checks while adding a same-run retry contract and an earlier frozen-media validation boundary.

evidence.command: Review the accepted recovery and preflight decision

current.reasoning: The retry workflow accepts only a release identity and reruns the validated original Product Release run; manual dispatch retries accept the dispatch head while retaining the registered merge identity. New failure metadata is additive to the ledger reader, input-only abandon is fail-closed when artifacts remain available, static output reuse is bound to identity, source and frozen input digest, and historical frozen catalogs may use the current verified compatibility tooling during preflight without changing source or input bytes.

scope_drift.description: The candidate is limited to Product Release recovery, failure context, frozen-media preflight, their workflows, focused tests and the owning runbook/spec/ADR evidence.

verified.reasoning: Focused release, workflow, media and notification contract tests pass; the preflight compatibility overlay is covered by the workflow contract test and keeps the original release identity/source/input proofs unchanged. An empirical GitHub Actions rerun drill remains required before this record can be treated as final runtime evidence.
